verdict.rationale: The only event-related evidence is that Hugging Face provides webhooks to receive real-time info about repos. That is a developer building block for constructing event-driven automation, not a documented way to define rules that trigger actions. The 'run a job' CLI item is a one-off action, not an event-triggered rule, so nothing in the pack shows a built-in rule or trigger-action capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
